images.name: quote
images.text: Say it's AI *in the first line.* Customers who find out halfway through feel tricked. The rest just want their appointment booked.

images.name: handoff
images.title: How the *handoff to a person* works
steps: A plain word like "person", said or typed, works at any point in the conversation.
Complaints, money it can't approve, and anyone upset or confused go to a person without being asked.
Name, account and the problem so far, so nobody has to repeat themselves.
"The front desk will call you before noon", not "someone will be in touch."
If nobody has called by noon, it flags it to the person in charge.
